purpose: Investigate whether missing fill in the Picard velocity ILU0 is a useful structural remedy for compatible linear budgets; retain negative complete-cost evidence.

method.sharedCore: oneLevelFillConnections and existing SparseSystem2D::factorILU0 on the expanded zero-initialized graph
method.symbolicRule: Original union-pattern entries have level 0; new level=level(i,j)+level(j,k)+1. Exactly one fill level connects only original neighbours i,k>pivot j. Generated edges never generate another level-1 edge.
method.numericSafeguards: existing positive diagonal/pivot and finite rules; no shift, replacement, symmetrization or fallback
method.scope: Explicit native API/research option; no production CLI velocity selector or default adoption.
method.dependency: independently implemented using existing native kernel; no PETSc or external factorization linked for this method

reusedBaseline.note: SHA-verified original matrices and current compensated-residual ILU0 results, no reassembly or rerun of 18 frozen baselines.

fullFlowControls.order: ILU0 / ILU1 / ILU1 / ILU0, serial; no concurrent test/build in these timings

cases.outlet16: square 16, manufactured outlet-poiseuille, nu=.1, zero pseudo-traction outlet, Schur/IC0
cases.sheared8: sheared 8, noslip-sheared, nu=.01, closed velocity boundary, corrected viscous pressure mass
cases.cylinder64: original 64-cell true cut-cell, nu=.1, static embedded wall, inlet (1,0), normal-velocity top/bottom and zero pseudo-traction right, Schur/IC0

fullFlowControls.driverLimit: Research cylinder adapter does not enable production CLI rejectBackflow or per-step checkpoint export; no whole CLI-policy cost claim.

validation.allowanceScope: existing polynomial regression in U,L units; no new physical threshold
validation.algebraControl: Nonsymmetric 3-row star becomes an exact solve with one fill level; 4-row graph rejects level-2 propagation; 256*epsilon*(1+rhs norm) is only this known-coefficient roundoff control.
validation.buildWarnings: 9 inherited conversion/shadow warnings in unchanged FlowAggregation2D.hpp; no product warning suppression added

conclusions.frozen: 16 product counts decrease, 2 increase; all 18 reach unchanged true residual target. Converged sheared state worsens 115->116 with IC0 and 94->100 with aggregation.
conclusions.factorStorage: factor coefficient count increases by about 23-29%; this is not total process memory
conclusions.completeCost: No consistent wall-clock improvement. Cylinder ILU1 is slower in both sequential observations. Do not use iteration counts as a speedup claim.
conclusions.fields: Max full-flow P1 velocity RMS 5.877e-13 m/s, pressure RMS <=9.338e-13 m2/s2 (absolute for outlets, gauge reported separately for closed); no physical accuracy qualification.
conclusions.next: At most a discriminating matched-budget original-cloud-system comparison, including symbolic/factor cost and storage. Do not sweep more fill levels based on these small controls. If inadequate, pursue the global coupled bottleneck rather than increasing fill by habit.
